item.title: Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts reopens in Oakland after $100M makeover, after 20 year absence
item.description: A ribbon-cutting ceremony held by Oakland Mayor Barbara Lee marked the grand reopening of Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts in Oakland. Legendary storyteller and Oakland native, Don Reed, kicked off the opening night performance along with Scott Silven's illusion show "The Lost Things."

item.title: A man is under arrest for assaulting U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost at the Sundance Film Festival
item.description: Democratic U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost wrote on X Saturday that he was punched in the face by a man who told Frost that President Donald Trump was going to deport him.

item.title: Vallejo police get help responding to 911 calls from Solano Co. sheriff deputies
item.description: Solano County sheriff's deputies have geared up to officially partner with the Vallejo Police Department in three designated areas of east and south Vallejo for a one-year program to help address the department's staffing crisis.

item.title: SF installs new trash cans designed to dispose of pizza boxes in North Beach neighborhood
item.description: San Francisco's North Beach is packed with pizzerias and for years, neighbors and businesses have complained about takeout boxes littering Washington Square Park. To try to alleviate the problem, the city installed two custom trash cans - designed specifically for the shape and size of pizza boxes.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Lingering clouds overnight, mostly sunny tomorrow
item.description: Our weather will remain dry tonight, but clouds will linger into the overnight hours, followed by clearing early tomorrow morning.

item.title: Super Bowl 60 is set and it's a rematch from 11 years ago: Patriots vs. Seahawks
item.description: Drake Maye vs. Sam Darnold. Two stingy defenses. A second-year head coach vs. a veteran coach in his second act. Super Bowl 60 is set and it's a rematch: The New England Patriots vs. the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Super Bowl 60: What to know about big game at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara
item.description: The Super Bowl is making its return to Levi's Stadium after 10 years. Here's everything you need to know about the big game.

item.title: Minnesota Timberwolves hold moment of silence for Alex Pretti ahead of game against Warriors
item.description: The Timberwolves held a moment of silence for Alex Pretti, the man killed by a federal officer in Minneapolis.

item.title: Geoffrey Mason, TV producer of 1972 Munich Olympics hostage crisis, dies at 85
item.description: Geoffrey Mason, who had a five-decade career in sports television and was best known as the coordinating producer for ABC's coverage of the 1972 Munich Olympic Games hostage crisis, has died.

item.title: SFO travelers face flight cancellations, delays due to massive winter storm: 'I'm ready to go home'
item.description: "I'm ready to go home," said one traveler. Bay Area airports are seeing some big ripple effects from frigid, snowy conditions back east. It's causing flight delays and headaches for travelers.
